name: Disney Infinity
description:
■What is Disney Infinity?
By reading character figures with a special reader (Disney Infinity Base),
This is a new game where you can freely play in the worldview of each work and the world of limitless imagination.
■3DS version...
In the 3DS version, you can enjoy a board game that follows the story.
Form a team with 3 characters! This is a game where 4 teams move around the board by rolling dice, aiming for victory while clearing various mini-games. There are over 50 mini-games with a wide variety of variations. Characters will level up each time you play, so create the strongest team!
